_notes: Each competitor entry MUST include a verified source_url and source_date for every numeric claim. Rows where any field is null will be hidden in the comparison UI. Only add a number when you can point to the brokerage's own published page.

_metrics.monthly_fee: Recurring monthly brokerage/desk fee in USD.
_metrics.transaction_fee: Per-deal transaction fee in USD (0 if none).
_metrics.split_pct: Agent's percentage of commission (100 = 100% to agent).
_metrics.franchise_fee_pct: Royalty/franchise percentage off the top (0 if none).
_metrics.annual_cap_usd: Maximum total the brokerage can collect per year (across splits/franchise). null if unverified or no published cap.
